method: Single isolated Chromium browser. Installed MV3 extension, controlled Bilibili fixture and 1080p60 VP9 input. Each variant changes one renderer or source path; source seeks to zero and warms up before eight-second measurements. Main-thread timings are API submission costs. Frame intervals and video drops do not measure physical display latency.
limits: Diagnostic variants change rendering behavior and are not the shipped implementation. Fresh and sequential windows run at different times and show different baseline load; differences do not isolate a single cause. Video count and callbacks do not measure physical display latency.
